protocol.authorization: User accepted annual-only/ST-only simplification and removed the 5,000-observation target.
protocol.target: New ST or *ST implementation in [May 1 Y, May 1 Y+1), among eligible non-ST firms at origin. This is not all-cause financial distress.
protocol.exclude_baseline: ST/*ST only; no quarterly-loss or audit-loss exclusion in the redesigned target.
protocol.ratio_note: All stock denominators are explicitly year-end balances; these are not average-balance ROA/ROE. No prior-year balance, share-count proxy, capex or expensed-interest input is required.

text.source: MD&A of the same preorigin annual report
text.representation: training-only character TF-IDF and truncated SVD on bounded text chunks
text.fit_scope: training documents only; identical fitted representation for every variant

model.attention: Financial representation queries multiple text chunks; padding masked; no singleton-key degeneration.
model.loss: binary cross entropy; any class weighting estimated from training only
model.concat_parameter_budget: Exactly matched to cross_attention using a three-width concatenation head

evaluation.primary: test average precision and paired difference, with company-cluster bootstrap intervals
evaluation.threshold: Select once on validation for each model/seed; never select on test
evaluation.unit: firm clusters retaining repeated company-year records
evaluation.adequacy: No arbitrary total-N target. Report event counts and distinct event firms in every split, interval widths and variability across seeds. If event counts or intervals cannot resolve an improvement, report inconclusive evidence; do not expand/stop the sample by test performance.
evaluation.claims: Predictive association, not causality, universal distress or guaranteed early warning.
evaluation.technical_minimum: At least two distinct positive firms and two distinct negative firms in every split for computation and cluster resampling. This is not a power or publication-sufficiency criterion; sparse events and wide intervals require inconclusive conclusions.

sampling.rule: Freeze all eligible observations at the source-availability snapshot, applying the same prespecified rules to every candidate; retain every exclusion/pending reason. No outcome-dependent replacements and no selection by test performance.

pending: Finish source-based input and industry adjudication
Freeze eligible source-availability subset before estimation
Interpret intervals and seed variability without assuming improvement

ST_source_operationalization.source: Audited unfiltered SZSE short-name change register, reconciled to official XLSX/API counts and listing/delisting exports
ST_source_operationalization.assumption: The official register records all ST/*ST name transitions; source errors or omissions cannot be ruled out by internal consistency checks.
ST_source_operationalization.reconstruction: Full normalized name chain and terminal name must agree; any conflict stays unresolved. ST at origin is excluded. An observed new transition gives label 1. Label 0 requires the full interval to be covered and no earlier delisting.
ST_source_operationalization.censoring: Delisting before the end without an observed ST transition leaves the label unknown.

input_verification.rule_based: Official filing-index identity, front-matter code/year, latest indexed preorigin full report, consolidated yuan statements, explicitly ordered current/comparative headers, anchored rows and accounting checks; uniquely bounded MD&A of at least 1000 non-space characters. Automatic checks are not described as manual verification.
input_verification.missingness: Uncollected required rows remain pending; only ratios with known zero denominators may be missing under automatic checks.

selection_rule: All eligible rows at this source-availability snapshot; common sample across all four models, no selection by model results. Pending/ambiguous/missing source and industry cases excluded with reasons in the hashed inventory.
limitations: Source-availability selection may be nonrandom; results do not represent all Shenzhen firms.
Rule-based source checks are not manual audits.
Technical class-support minimum does not establish statistical power.
Registered ST changes measure a regulatory endpoint, not all financial distress.
